design: LatestMarketSnapshotStore keeps (inode, consumed byte offset, line count, last 4096 bytes before offset); _sync_locked preads only [offset,size), consumes only newline-terminated rows, and rebuilds from zero on inode change, shrink, changed tail bytes (in-place compaction followed by growth), or same-size/new-mtime rewrite. Own appends/compactions advance the position without re-parsing. Journal format, _market_snapshots_from_lines (deployed reader, byte-identical) and compaction output unchanged; a separate _fold_market_snapshot_lines applies the same per-line rules on top of existing state.
smoke_command: python3 scripts/ci_source_ingestion_test_shards.py --shards 4 --max-test-seconds 300 -> exit 0; 867 passed, 11 skipped per last shard summary; ran 2100 (skipped 22) of 2100 collected

changed_existing_assertion.change: monkeypatch target renamed from _market_snapshots_from_lines to _fold_market_snapshot_lines (the incremental parser); calls==[] and calls==[1] assertions unchanged. Justification: the incremental path no longer calls the whole-file reader function, which must stay byte-identical to the deployed reader (test_deployed_reader_reads_compacted_journal_identically).
